t: An ESP32-S3 board with LoRa radio, GPS, and a small color screen.
steps: Buy the Wireless Tracker V2 from the Heltec store or a reseller. Pick the band for your country.
Screw on the LoRa and GPS antennas before you power it up.
Plug the board into a computer with a USB-C cable.
Open the Meshtastic web flasher in a browser and install the firmware.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Set your region in the app to match local radio rules.
Take it outside and wait for a GPS fix. Then send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE with the Heltec ESP32 board package and try a GPS example.
meta: Open Board. From $32.97. A few stores.
